text:
maria-partnerships: Hey team — Nimbus sent the draft solution brief and a suggested SE quote. Can design + marketing + legal scan for logo usage, color, and quote language? Link: https://files.redwood.co/partners/nimbus/nimbus-brief-draft.pdf

oliver-design: quick skim — their logomark is touching the headline on page 2. Clearspace needs to be enforced. Ask for the original SVG (not a flattened PNG). Also their PNG has a blue halo; looks like exported on white.

jensen-partner: I can grab the SVG. The proposed quote is: "Redwood cut inference costs by 42%" from their SE — they included a POC stat. Do we have guidance on publishing exact percentages?

sophie-marketing: prefer avoiding raw numbers unless partner signs off with provenance. Suggest alternate phrasing: "significant cost reductions during a POC" and add a footnote if they provide a data source.

raj-legal: rule of thumb — any customer metric needs written attestation. We also must avoid implying a guaranteed outcome. If Nimbus gives a signed line saying the POC showed 42% reduction, we can publish that verbatim but keep partner attribution.

jensen-partner: pinged Nimbus PM for SVG + signed attestation. ETA EOD. Also asked for SE headshot and title for attribution.

oliver-design: nit: Nimbus brand color in their assets is `#0A74FF`. That HEX works on white but their supplied PNG has a faint halo. Request transparent background or the raw vector. Minimum logo size note: 48px for the logomark.

brandbot: Asset uploaded by jensen-partner: https://assets.redwood.co/partners/nimbus/logo_nimbus_v2.svg

sophie-marketing: copy suggestion if we can't get a signed stat in time: "During a POC with Nimbus, Redwood's serving runtime contributed to reduced inference costs reported by Nimbus." Keeps it factual and attributed.

raj-legal: minor edit — change "our POC" to "a POC with Nimbus" to avoid implying Redwood executed it. If they provide a signed wording we can use the partner's exact phrasing.

jensen-partner: Nimbus PM replied and attached attestation: "We confirm the POC observed a 42% reduction in token generation cost versus our prior setup." They granted permission to cite the stat. File: https://files.nimbus.com/attestations/nimbus-poc-042.pdf

oliver-design: perfect — with the stat we can do a callout pull-quote. Recommendation: serif 48px for the quote, accent bar using `#0A74FF`, 20px left padding, and the logomark at 48px min. I'll mock it.

sophie-marketing: also need the SE headshot + full job title for the quote attribution. Jensen — can you get that from Nimbus?

jensen-partner: asked — they said yes, will drop into this thread.

oliver-design: uploaded mock v2: https://files.redwood.co/mocks/nimbus-brief-mock-v2.png — adjusted clearspace and quote style.

maria-partnerships: timeline check — design mock due tomorrow 12:00, legal to sign off after edits, marketplace tile needs approved SVG + 2-line description by Friday so listing can go live next week.

raj-legal: I'll do a final pass once the mock is in and the partner-signed attestation is in place. No further red flags now — just preserve partner wording for the stat.

sophie-marketing: small copy tweak applied in draft: "During a POC with Nimbus, Redwood's serving runtime reduced inference costs in their workload." Raj — is that ok or prefer partner copy?

raj-legal: that wording is fine as long as the partner attestation exists. Keep the attribution: "— Nimbus SE, [Name]."

jensen-partner: Nimbus uploaded headshot + title and confirmed exact quote line for use. Files: https://assets.nimbus.com/se_headshot.jpg, title: Senior Platform SE

oliver-design: updated mock with headshot and final callout: https://files.redwood.co/mocks/nimbus-brief-final.png — ready for production assets prep.

maria-partnerships: marking as approved to proceed to marketplace collateral prep. Final actions: jensen to confirm SVG in marketplace size variants, oliver to export production PNG/SVGs, sophie to prepare 2-line marketplace blurb, raj to do final signoff on wording. Target: marketplace draft by Fri. :white_check_mark:

jensen-partner: on it, will upload the size variants and confirm when done.

brandbot: Marketplace draft scheduled: 2026-03-25 09:00 UTC (auto-scheduled)

maria-partnerships: thanks everyone — closing this thread once the marketplace draft is live.
